assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
There is a concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia contributing to these symptoms
CPT 93271 Cardiac Event Monitoring is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
The clinical indication note specifically orders a cardiac event monitor to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
